# RadioGroup

A set of native radios sharing one name (D104). The browser supplies the keyboard: Tab enters on the checked radio, and the arrows move and select. Inside `Field group` the fieldset and legend form and name the group, so this adds no role; standalone it is `role="radiogroup"` and needs `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. A required or invalid Field makes every radio `required` and `aria-invalid`.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | no | `Radio` children. |
| `name` | `string` | — | no | The radios' shared `name`. Generated when absent. |
| `value` | `string` | — | no | The selected value (controlled). |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | no | The initially selected value (uncontrolled). |
| `onValueChange` | `((value: string) => void)` | — | no | Called with the value of the radio the user selects. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | false | no | Disables every radio in the group. |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | vertical | no | Stack the radios, or lay them in a row. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | no | Accessible name when the group stands alone. Inside `Field group` the legend names the group instead. |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLDivElement>` | — | no | Forwarded ref to the root element. |
| `className` | `string` | — | no | Additional CSS class name(s) merged onto the component's root element. |

## Keyboard & assistive tech

| Keys | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Tab | Enters the group on the checked radio, or the first one; one tab stop for the group. |
| Arrow keys | Move to the next or previous radio and select it (native radios sharing one name). |

Native radios sharing one name (D104). Inside Field group the fieldset and legend form and name the group, so RadioGroup adds no role; standalone it is role="radiogroup" and needs aria-label or aria-labelledby. A required or invalid Field makes every radio required and aria-invalid.

## Theming

Override `--psi-radio-group-*` custom properties at any scope.



## Rules

- One accent per visual group; everything else neutral or ghost.
- danger only for actions with real consequences.
- Sizes are px numbers (24|32|40|48), never S/M/L.
- Typography tokens are --psi-text-{size}-{lineHeight}-{weight}.
- Override component tokens (--psi-{component}-*), not semantic tokens, for one-off theming.
- --psi-button-font overrides button typography across all sizes (documented D34 override; ember → mono).
- Wrap labeled form controls in Field — label association, description/error line, aria-describedby and aria-invalid come wired; don't hand-roll label+message rows.
- Field is for a control with a *visible* label. A toolbar filter control named by aria-label or placeholder takes neither a Field nor a hand-rolled label row — compare filter-toolbar (no labels) with table-pagination ("Rows per page" visible, so Field). Filters with visible labels submitted together by a Find button are filter-form: a Toolbar as="form" align="start" of Fields with one-line labels, where a field's error line is the Field's own and hangs below its control (D87, D92).
- Use Dialog for blocking modal flows — title/footer slots, dismissible gate; danger stays on the footer Buttons, one accent per group.
